summary: This roundup previews seven local music festivals and events running from September 15 to December 3, 2023, each designed to showcase emerging artists alongside established acts. The events span genres including indie folk-rock, blues, hip-hop, acoustic singer-songwriter, experimental, bluegrass and electronic music. Many include dedicated segments for newcomers, such as 'Moonlight Spotlight' and 'Rise-Up Rhythms', and several add art, workshops, crafts or food.
one_line: A roundup of seven local music festivals from September to December 2023 spotlighting emerging talent across many genres.
key_facts: JamFest September takes place on September 15, 2023 at Riverfront Park and is directed by Miranda Chen.
The indie folk-rock band The Willow Wailers, fronted by Ellie Masters, is featured at JamFest September and releases its first EP just in time for the festival.
JamFest includes a parallel art market and mural installations alongside the music.
Blues Under the Moon returns for its fifth season on September 22, 2023 at the historic Millbank Riverside.
Lenny "Six Strings" Adams headlines Blues Under the Moon, and its 'Moonlight Spotlight' segment lets selected up-and-coming musicians each perform a set.
UrbanBeat Festival is on October 7, 2023 at Central Square downtown and features hip-hop duo Rhymes and Reason (Jase 'Rhyme' Carter and producer 'Reason' Delgado).
UrbanBeat's 'Rise-Up Rhythms' segment spotlights emerging local DJs and rap battlers.
Acoustic Autumn is an open-air concert on October 15, 2023 at Elmwood Park featuring singer-songwriter Sasha Greene and encouraging duets and impromptu jams.
The Indie Innovators festival is on November 4, 2023, features The Neon Collective (frontman Alex Knight, synthpop and alt-rock fusion), and offers workshops and panels with music producers.
Rural Rhythms Festival is on November 18, 2023 at Oak Grove Farm, headlined by The Homestead Band, a bluegrass group of siblings Henry, Clarice, and Benny Taylor.
Rural Rhythms also showcases local crafts, homestyle food, and folk dance.
Synthesizing Soundscapes is on December 3, 2023 at the city's newest digital arts center, featuring DJ Ecliptic and 'Electronic Jam Sessions' for emerging DJs.
